oil.when: 2025 K5 (service interval countdown shown in the instrument cluster)
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed (or the scheduled service has been done).
Switch the car on and bring up the Service mode screen in the instrument cluster display, where the service interval is shown.
Press and hold the OK button for more than 1 second. The countdown restarts at the miles and days that were set before.
Switch the car off and on again and check that the Service in or Service required message no longer appears.
oil.note: Checked in the 2025 K5 owner's manual. The manual says to see a Kia dealer to change the interval itself. The countdown can be wrong after the battery has been disconnected or run flat.

oil.when: 2021 K5 (service interval items in the cluster User Settings)
steps: Reset only after the oil and filter have actually been changed (or the scheduled service has been done).
With the car parked and switched on, open the User Settings menu in the instrument cluster display.
Find the service interval items (Enable Service Interval, Adjust Interval and Reset).
Choose Reset to restart the service interval countdown.
oil.note: Checked in the 2021 K5 owner's manual, which says to see a Kia dealer to use the service interval menu. The countdown can be wrong after the battery has been disconnected or run flat.

tpms.when: 2025 K5 (sensor in each wheel; no reset button)
steps: Set all four tires to the cold pressure on the label on the driver's door pillar, checking them before driving or after the car has sat a few hours.
There is no reset button or menu for the tire pressure light. Once every tire is at or slightly above the recommended pressure, the light turns off by itself.
Drive for a few minutes. Each tire's pressure shows in the information mode of the instrument cluster about 1 to 2 minutes after you start driving, so you can confirm all four.
If the light stays on, recheck each tire with an accurate gauge. Air-station gauges can read off, so the tire may still be a little under the label pressure.
tpms.note: If the tire pressure light blinks for about a minute at startup and then stays on, the monitoring system has a fault; setting the pressures will not clear it, so have it checked. Cold weather lowers tire pressure and can turn the light on even if the tires were set correctly in warm weather.
